title: Headless Why Can't We Be Friends? (VMS42), Philip Lem's side: the player takes his job to blow up the sulfur (11)

actions.text: Path: in Vault 19 Philip Lem greets the player; asked about the vault (Topic031, which shares Topic007's line 0x00146E1D), he asks the player to blow up Cooke's sulfur and the player agrees (Topic142: 11, LemGoDestroySulfur, the blue keycard). The sulfur's explosion and the stages after it (12, 13) are set by nothing in FalloutNV.esm. Stand-in: the trip to Vault 19 by move_player.
